title: Utilizing waste lithium-ion batteries for the production of graphite-carbon nanotube composites as oxygen electrocatalysts in zinc–air batteries
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00526K, Paper

Reio Praats, Jani Sainio, Milla Vikberg, Lassi Klemettinen, Benjamin P. Wilson, Mari Lundström, Ivar Kruusenberg, Kerli Liivand
This study presents a new method to transform Li-ion battery recycling residue into a high-performance oxygen electrocatalyst for zinc–air batteries.
